about: Every graph in this repo that swaps a person, one row each: the graph, its core model, what it swaps, a render made here, and its licence. A row is shown as done only when its render is in the repo; a graph whose proof is still being rendered is listed as coming, with no picture. Every person in these renders is invented and AI-generated.

rows.name: Recast
rows.swaps: the whole character: face, hair and clothes
rows.inputs: one picture of the character and one video
rows.looked: Source and recast side by side: the camera push, the second cook and the flambé are kept, and the chef becomes the red-bearded sailor from the picture.
rows.flaw: Mid-clip the flame comes out paler than in the source.
rows.licence: MiniMax H3 Community License: excludes the US, EU, UK and South Korea, outputs included

rows.name: SCAIL 2
rows.swaps: the whole character in a clip
rows.inputs: one picture of the person and one driving video
rows.looked: An invented man takes over an invented woman's clip, wave and gestures kept. Looked at frame by frame.
rows.flaw: 3.4 s per segment in this graph. The face drifts a little from the picture when the head turns.
rows.licence: MIT on Hugging Face, Apache-2.0 on GitHub; the lightx2v distill LoRA is Apache-2.0

rows.name: Wan Animate 2
rows.swaps: the performer: the person in a picture takes over a clip's movement
rows.inputs: one picture of the person and one driving video
rows.looked: An invented woman follows an invented woman's clip. Looked at frame by frame.
rows.flaw: It makes its own plain background rather than keeping the clip's, and the face reads younger than the picture.

rows.name: Qwen outfit swap
rows.inputs: two pictures: the person and the garment
rows.looked: Best on our test: the coat kept its full length and buttons, and the jeans and face stayed the same.
rows.flaw: Tested on one coat and one person only.
rows.licence: Qwen Research License (research or evaluation only); the LoRA is rent-only at its source

rows.name: Klein 4B try-on
rows.inputs: two pictures: the person and the garment
rows.looked: The cleanest on our tests: it replaced the whole outfit on both the coat and the dress and kept the face.
rows.flaw: The LoRA is rent-only on Civitai, so check before selling pictures.
rows.licence: Klein 4B Apache-2.0; the LoRA is rent-only on Civitai

rows.name: Klein 9B try-on, two references + LoRA
rows.inputs: two pictures: the person and the garment
rows.looked: Quicker than 4B, and it replaced the whole outfit.
rows.flaw: On our dress test the colour came out paler and the hem shorter. The LoRA was made for Base 9B and runs here on the distilled 9B.
rows.licence: FLUX Non-Commercial License (Klein 9B); the LoRA is rent-only on Civitai

rows.name: Klein 9B try-on, two references
rows.inputs: two pictures: the person and the garment
rows.flaw: It also recoloured the trousers to match the coat.

rows.name: Klein 9B, three references
rows.swaps: the character into a scene: character, outfit and place from three pictures
rows.inputs: three pictures: the character, the outfit and the place
rows.looked: Three pictures in (an invented painter, a rust field jacket, an empty greenhouse), and he stands in the greenhouse wearing the jacket. Face and build held; the pockets and collar carried over. The render shows the three references beside the result.
rows.flaw: A slight smile was added and the hair came out a little lighter in the warm light. His own trousers stay.

rows.name: Qwen outfit swap, turbo
rows.inputs: two pictures: the person and the garment
rows.licence: Qwen-Image Apache-2.0; the LoRA is rent-only at its source

rows.name: Krea 2 identity edit
rows.core: Krea 2 Turbo + Krea 2 Identity Edit LoRA (community fine-tune, not by Krea)
rows.swaps: the person in an existing scene
rows.inputs: two pictures: the scene and the person
rows.licence: Krea 2 Community License: commercial use only for companies under US$1,000,000 annual revenue; the Identity Edit LoRA is a community fine-tune, not by Krea
rows.looked: An invented man at a rainy tram shelter is swapped for an invented lifeguard. The street, shelter, shop window and light held, and the face matches the picture. The render shows both inputs beside the result.
rows.flaw: The new person brought his own arms-out pose and bare feet instead of taking the man's stance, and the camera sits a little closer.
